messages.author: David Case
messages.body:
> I have recently downloaded the Amber22 (academic version), but couldn't
> find the run_cmake installation script in the amber22_src directory. Kindly
> advise how to proceed with the installation.
You need to also download AmberTools23, and untar that file into the same tree (headed by "amber22_src") that
contains Amber22.
....dac
